name: White Diamonds Eau de Toilette
editorialDescription: A classic white-floral eau de toilette, launched in 1991 and still widely sold. The Perfume Shop lists lily, neroli and tuberose on top, orris, narcissus and amber in the heart, and sandalwood, patchouli and oakmoss in the base. It's a fuller, more traditional floral than modern fresh florals such as the Daisy line.
keyFeatures: Top notes: lily, neroli, tuberose (per The Perfume Shop)
advantages: A long-established fragrance with a well-documented note list
Widely available, usually in several bottle sizes
disadvantages: Retailers list somewhat different notes, so expect variation in descriptions
A traditional floral style that may feel heavy if you prefer fresh, fruity scents
suits: People who like classic, full white florals
Anyone looking for a long-established fragrance rather than a new release
skipIf: You react to fragranced products; FDA notes fragrance ingredients may be listed only as "fragrance" on U.S. labels
You prefer light, fresh or fruity scents; try a sample first
buyingConsiderations: Confirm 'Eau de Toilette' and the size in the listing title
Prefer listings sold by the brand or Amazon to reduce counterfeit and old-stock risk
Check the box is sealed on arrival
